summary: Integra Resources Corp. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release with an interim operational update for Q2 2026. The release reports record mining and ore-stacking rates at its Florida Canyon mine, with gold production of 16,379 ounces (up 30% quarter-over-quarter) and provides full-year guidance of 70,000-75,000 ounces. There is no mention of any M&A transaction, strategic review, activist campaign, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special situation. The filing is a routine operational and production update from a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a domestic operational update.
